# TXLookup

> Ask Texas anything. Public civic intelligence over Texas and Austin public datasets with sourced, cited answers. Built by AISOFT.

## Public Pages
- [Home](https://txlookup.xyz/): Ask questions across Texas public datasets.
- [Datasets](https://txlookup.xyz/datasets): Indexed public data sources and freshness.
- [Reports](https://txlookup.xyz/reports): Curated public civic reports.

## Markdown for AI Agents
Request `/` with `Accept: text/markdown` or fetch `/ai/index.md` directly.

## APIs & Privacy
- Public read endpoints live under `/api/*` (excluding `/api/admin/*`).
- Admin routes (`/admin`, `/api/admin`) are private and disallowed for crawlers.
- Contact: hello@aisoft.us
